name: doubt
quote: I don't know if she's going to be ok.
description: Not trusting how much to rely on particular prediction or idea.

variations.name: self doubt
variations.description: Being uncertain that your knowledge or skills are up to a particular task.

variations.name: propositional doubt
variations.description: Uncertainty about whether to believe something thas has been offered for consideration.

variations.name: foundational doubt
variations.description: Concern that something you have relied on as an important life pattern might be incorrect or oversimplified.
examples: A social group told you to believe something. Evidence suggests that something might not always be true. They will be disappointed that you're even considering this.

commentaries.quote: Since we're organic pattern-processors that prefer certainty, doubt is often considered annoying gunk that's clogging up the system. Doubt is actually healthy in the right amount because our over-simplified patterns are never perfect in an infinitely complex world.
It can be traumatic to doubt important chunks of your belief system when it comes with social costs and loss of confidence in your patterns.

Frequent doubt is a sign that your patterns may need to become more generalized to handle the world's actual complexity. A complete lack of doubt is much worse - it means your patterns are way too simple to explain the real world and that you've turned off a key aspect of being a mature human.

conditions: You're uncertain about whether to rely on particular perception or pattern.
